queries.query: LLM error modes network configuration, hallucination, misconfiguration, Cisco Juniper ACLs, causes and examples
queries.rationale: Directly discover documented cases and taxonomy of LLM/LLM-agent failures producing incorrect or unsafe network configs (phenomenon + concrete examples).
source_preferences: vendor engineering blogs (Cisco, Juniper, Google Cloud)

queries.query: Failure modes of agentic AI in operational workflows, automation for NetOps, unsafe actions, emergent agentic failures
queries.rationale: Capture literature on agentic/auto-executing agents making harmful or unsafe operational decisions beyond static generation errors.

queries.query: mechanisms leading to LLM mistakes in domain-specific generation: training data gaps, distribution shift, prompt brittleness, chain-of-thought errors
queries.rationale: Identify hypothesized and empirically demonstrated mechanisms (why failures occur) applicable to NetOps.

queries.query: intent-to-configuration translation: natural language intent parsing for network configuration, intent parsing systems, semantic parsing for configs
queries.rationale: Survey methods that map operator intent to configs, including LLM-based approaches and classical semantic parsers (relevant baseline methods).

queries.query: generate-validate-repair architectures for network configs, verifier-assisted LLM workflows, Batfish + LLM, specification-guided repair
queries.rationale: Collect prior methods that pair generation with verification and repair loops; find tool integrations (Batfish, static analyzers) in literature.

queries.query: formal verification of network configurations, SMT/Model checking for routing, ACL verification, correctness specifications for networks
queries.rationale: Survey formal methods and validators used to check configuration correctness, to use as ground-truth validators or compare to LLM checks.

queries.query: constrained/controlled generation techniques for safe code or config generation: constrained decoding, templates, guarded generation, instruction-tuning for safety
queries.rationale: Identify applicable constrained-generation techniques to reduce unsafe outputs in NetOps contexts.

queries.query: bounded self-correction and verifier-in-the-loop methods for LLMs: self-ask, self-repair, iterative refinement, tool-assisted chain-of-thought
queries.rationale: Collect evidence on self-correction strategies and their empirical effectiveness, to consider as mitigations or components.

queries.query: benchmarks for LLMs on networking/AIOps tasks: dataset descriptions, evaluation protocols, limitations and critiques
queries.rationale: Assess existing benchmarks and their validity for operational NetOps tasks; find critiques about ecological validity and overfitting.

queries.query: evaluation metrics for network-configuration correctness and safety: semantic equivalence, reachability tests, policy compliance, simulation-based metrics
queries.rationale: Locate operationally meaningful metrics that can serve as evaluation criteria rather than generic NLP metrics.

queries.query: network emulation and validation environments (Mininet, GNS3, ns-3, Batfish) used for testing configs, pros/cons, reproducible setups
queries.rationale: Identify practical evaluation platforms and their fidelity trade-offs for validating generated configs or workflows.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop and operator-AI collaboration studies in NetOps, trust, explainability, override mechanics
queries.rationale: Survey work on human oversight, trust calibration, and hybrid workflows—important neighbouring work and mitigations.

queries.query: case studies of network outages caused by misconfiguration or automation errors, postmortems, operator lessons learned
queries.rationale: Gather operational impact evidence and real-world failure patterns to motivate threat models and metrics.
source_preferences: Operator postmortems (Cloudflare, Fastly, Google), incident reports, IETF drafts

queries.query: privacy, safety, and regulatory considerations for autonomous NetOps agents, compliance, auditability, provenance
queries.rationale: Find literature on non-technical constraints—provenance, audit trails, regulatory compliance relevant to deploying autonomous NetOps agents.

queries.query: AIOps surveys and related work: ML for network operations, anomaly detection, change validation, configuration synthesis
queries.rationale: Map broader AIOps literature that informs neighbouring methods, evaluation paradigms, and datasets.

inclusion_criteria: Works (peer-reviewed or reputable preprints) focused on LLMs, agentic systems, or ML applied to network configuration or NetOps tasks
Papers, tool docs, datasets, and operator postmortems that provide empirical data, method descriptions, or evaluation protocols
Sources published or preprinted through 2026 inclusive, prioritizing 2020–2026
Publicly accessible primary sources (papers, code repos, datasets, official blog post/postmortems)
Formal-methods and verification literature applicable to network config correctness
exclusion_criteria: Opinion pieces or blog posts without empirical evidence or method details
Papers unrelated to network operations or configuration (purely general NLP theory without operational implications) unless they introduce methods directly applicable to NetOps
Non-public or proprietary datasets/tools behind paywalls that cannot be inspected
Work published before 2010 unless it is a foundational method directly cited by recent NetOps/verification work
date_rationale: Rapid developments in LLMs and AIOps over recent years make recent literature (2020–2026) most relevant; include 2015–2019 selectively for foundational verification, emulation, or NetOps systems work; prioritize the newest preprints and conference proceedings through 2026 for current methods and critiques.
